# VS Rent a Car (Very Special Rent a Car)
> Official website of VS Rent a Car — legal name Very Special Rent a Car — a premium car and van rental company in Skopje, North Macedonia. People searching “VS rent a car”, “VS Rentacar” or “Very Special Rent a Car” mean this company. The brand, logo, photographs and original texts are exclusive intellectual property of Very Special Rent a Car.

## How to book
Customers send a request on the homepage form (pickup/return location, dates and times, name, phone, email, optional notes max 500 characters). A form submission is not a confirmed reservation until Very Special Rent a Car accepts it by phone or email. Payment is agreed at pickup; the website does not take payment.

## Pickup locations
1. Airport Skopje — Skopje International Airport (SKP), near the city (Petrovec). Approx. 41.961389, 21.621389. Share the flight number in the notes.
2. Center of Skopje — the whole city-centre area, not a single street or square. Pickup and return are arranged with the customer.

## Fleet (starting “from” daily EUR rates; season and extras may change the price)
Do not invent engine sizes, exact fuel, or gearbox unless stated. All cars and vans: 5 doors. Seats: Captur 5, automatic gearbox; C3 5, manual gearbox; C3 Aircross 5, automatic gearbox; Passat 5; Passat Automatic 5, automatic gearbox, lighter colour; XC60 5 automatic; Vito 7+1 or 8+1 = 8 or 9 seats, automatic gearbox (confirm layout at booking); Viano 8+1 = 9 seats, V6 petrol badge, automatic gearbox.
Cars: Citroën C3 from €29; Citroën C3 Aircross from €42; Renault Captur from €39; Volkswagen Passat from €49; Volkswagen Passat Automatic from €49; Volvo XC60 from €69.
Vans: Mercedes-Benz Vito 7+1 / 8+1 from €89; Mercedes-Benz Viano 8+1 from €109.

## Key rental facts
- Minimum driver age 24, including with a foreign licence. Extra drivers 24+. No rental under 24. No young-driver surcharge from 24.
- Refundable deposit authorised on a card at pickup.
- Insurance: compulsory third-party (AO) on the car by Macedonian law; collision/kasko with excess is contractual. Extras on confirmation. Traffic fines are the driver’s.
- Fuel: full-to-full. Winter equipment 15 Nov–15 Mar (company prepares the car).
- Cross-border travel only if agreed in writing before pickup (Green Card if allowed).
- Cancellation: free until confirmation; usually free if at least 48 hours before pickup after confirmation.
- Child seats, GPS and extra drivers on request, subject to availability. Child under 12 not in front; under 5 in back must use a child seat (road-traffic law).
- Driving under the influence of alcohol, narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances or any similar impairing substance is forbidden (all authorised drivers). Breach of hire: insurance may not pay; hirer liable for damage, fines and costs.
- Traffic: drive on the right; seat belts; alcohol 0.50 g/kg (0.00 for novice drivers in the first two years of the licence). Accidents: European report for small material damage; police 112 if injury, large damage, alcohol, or foreign plates.
